messages:
Asha: Quick sync — we need a tight copy pass for the website pages (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) + a short launch post series and a webinar landing flow. Goal: clarity for ops teams and devs, and a funnel for inbound leads. Can people drop 2 hero lines + 3 bullets each by EOD?
Ben: Timeline works. I can map post cadence: teaser -> benchmark thread -> webinar invite -> recap. Suggest 3 short posts (50-80 words) each.
Priya: For messaging, emphasize predictable latency + cost levers. Avoid jargon-heavy lines. One-liner idea: "Inference that scales with your SLAs, not your ops team."
Liam: Design can make hero variants work. Need exact CTAs: "Try Hosted", "Reserve Dedicated", "Request Private" — any alternate verbs?
Sam: Drafted quick microcopy — dropping options below. Also added a short webinar hook.
Sam: ```Hosted hero A: High-throughput inference, ready out of the box.
Hosted bullets: 1) Simple REST + SDKs, 2) Streaming & function calls, 3) Predictable pricing and quotas
Hosted hero B: Start small, scale fast: hosted LLM inference with cost controls.
---
Dedicated hero A: Guaranteed capacity for production workloads.
Dedicated bullets: 1) Reserved GPU pools, 2) Autoscale + burst, 3) SLA-backed latency
Dedicated hero B: Predictable performance for mission-critical apps.
---
Private hero A: Bring inference into your VPC or on-prem.
Private bullets: 1) Customer-managed networking, 2) KMS/HSM integrations, 3) Audit logs & compliance
Private hero B: Private deployments with enterprise controls.
```
Priya: These read nicely. For the webinar landing, we need a 1-line benefit, 2 bullets (what attendees learn), and a short signup CTA.
Sam: Webinar hook: "How to cut inference cost by 3x without sacrificing latency". Bullets: "1) Real workload batching & caching patterns; 2) Model & quantization tradeoffs; 3) Routing for reliability". CTA: "Save my seat"
Olivia: Quick analytics input — our benchmark thread that did best had a hero with explicit % cost savings and a CTA tied to a demo. Link: https://redwood.internal/benchmarks/2026-llm-inference (internal). Recommend variant test: one hero with % savings, one hero with feature-led line.
Ben: Good call. Routing note: inbound leads from Hosted CTA should go to self-serve signup. Dedicated CTA -> SDR queue tag "Dedicated-Interest". Private CTA -> Enterprise sales pipeline, require contact form with security checkbox. I'll update lead flows in HubSpot.
Liam: For hero imagery, avoid generic robots. Use abstract infra visuals + latency graph thumbnail. Can we get a small animated KPI strip for the benchmark numbers?
Asha: Action items — Sam to produce final copy variants by 4pm; Liam to mock hero + KPI strip by EOD; Olivia to export benchmark numbers & suggested % for the hero; Ben to wire lead routing; Priya to prep webinar brief. I'll compile and schedule a draft post cadence for next week. :sparkles:
launch-bot: Reminder — "Marketing content deadline" set for 2026-07-21 16:00 UTC.
Priya: Quick QA: keep each hero < 8 words if possible and make CTAs verb-first. Also add microcopy under CTAs: "No credit card" for Hosted, "Talk to sales" for Dedicated, "Request eval" for Private.
Sam: Noted. Will return with tightened lines and plain-language bullets.
Ben: I'll draft the 3-post cadence once Sam confirms the final hero lines.
Asha: Thanks team — feel free to drop links to drafts here.
